notes.title: Syncfall : Major Update 2
notes.content:
Seven Cities v0.2.0 — Syncfall Update Now Live

We’ve just launched the biggest update to Seven Cities yet. The Syncfall update introduces the first chapter of the campaign, new systems, skills, enemies, and a complete overhaul of the passive system. If you've had a chance to play, we'd be grateful if you left an honest review. Your feedback helps us continue improving the game and shape what comes next.

⚠️Note: Existing save files will be reset due to major system changes and incompatibility.

New Content and Features
Chapter 1: Campaign Launch

 The first chapter of the Seven Cities story is now available, including 15 narrative-driven main quests that lay the foundation of the ARPIX simulation.
 Each level of the chapter 1 of the campaign has been updated and improved.
 Also each level has their own dedicated pool of enemies.
 Add a waypoint system to travel better and faster


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/59ab028194d038fe991c2613f9904b363f8bacf7.png
New Character Skins
Four new character skins are available:

 The Tech Nerd
 The Specialist
 The Salesman
 The Oracle


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/3bfe5c7b142dc26b9f081fbe243f0f57f86a7414.png
Character Customization
Players can now change the colors of their character’s clothing and accessories during character creation.

New Endgame Mode: Syncfall
Unlocked at level 60, Syncfall introduces extraction shooter mechanics to the hack-and-slash core. This is a high-risk, high-reward mode designed for experienced players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/c14a3bb99ec72002da81a4764b82592242d42424.png
Mailbox System
Loot left behind during missions will now be sent to your mailbox if your inventory is full, reducing item loss during gameplay.

Leak System
Rework and update of the leak system, that does apply buff and debuff on specific damage like DOT from elemental damage.
It's exacly like to ailment on other games
A youtube video and steam & discord post dedicated on this will be publised later this week.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/a48d220ad0b721ab3a1892ed33eb934cb266eb01.png
Passive System Overhaul
The passive system has been completely reworked. Starting at level 2, players now receive dedicated passive points. The new interface is modular and tier-based, encouraging more meaningful build paths.

 23 new passive modules have been added
 Over 200 passive abilities are now available
 Several new mechanics introduced through major passives

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/e0e902e30ed78654d1d87605d75481f0c4ab67dd.png

Level Cap Increased
The maximum player level has been increased from 60 to 70.

New Skills
Two new skills have been added:
Teleport – Instantly move to the position of your mouse cursor. Includes 4 specialization nodes.
Server Tempest – Summon a tornado of energy that deals area damage. Includes 10 specialization nodes.

Additional skills will be added gradually over the next 14 days.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/d88101f1fa820c96273d45a9ed09854e8806babe.png
New Enemy Types
Five new enemy types are now live:

 Holographic Bear
 Holographic Tiger
 Healer Robot
 Syphon Guardian
 Explosive Guardian

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/4a8c7eb1dc56ed45417029a22afc9029dd93f313.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/981545ab80076633aeee62b499c4a03b1678eb12.png
Interface and Visual Improvements

 Ground item visuals reworked for easier visibility and interaction
 Equipment names now indicate their intended build paths
 Enemy health bars updated to clearly show rarity
 New character skill panel shows attached specialization nodes
 Robot passives can now be changed without altering form
 Launch screen and main camp visuals updated
 HUD scaling improved in the options panel
 Activity difficulty levels are now more clearly labeled
 Improved UI responsiveness and performance
 Increased number of enemies on each map
 Improved localisation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/2daab5d98e334c53293f7449d74cf83fabc0a7ab.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622114/69c0321c8ee2793606d6db918312ac923ac3ea72.png

Balance Adjustments

 Damage increased for several weapons
 Magazine size increased for select guns
 Shotgun fire rate reduced slightly
 Fixes and System Updates
 Fixed display issue with hardcore mode selection
 Fixed minimap scaling bug on Madison for resolutions above 1080p
 Fixed tutorial display issues across maps and Engineers
 Added a backup system to recover potentially corrupted save data
 General performance and UI optimizations across the board
 Improve localisation
 Adding more detail on stat description


Sound design
Add and update sound design on weapons, skill, environment to improve impact and ambiance.

🚀 That's Just the Beginning...
The Syncfall update is the biggest leap forward yet for Seven Cities, and it sets the stage for what's to come. Whether you're diving into Chapter 1 of the campaign, testing your limits in Syncfall, or experimenting with new builds and passives — we can’t wait to see what you’ll create and conquer.

🧠 Your feedback matters — please leave a review, share your thoughts on Discord, and help shape the future of Seven Cities.
💬 Join the conversation with other Outsiders on discord and stay updated on upcoming features, dev logs, and community events.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Stay synced, stay sharp — and we’ll see you in the Arpix outsiders.

— The Seven Cities Team

notes.content:
Seven Cities Hotfix Patch Notes - August 15, 2024

Outsiders,

We’ve been hard at work addressing your feedback and making important updates to improve your experience in Seven Cities. Here’s what’s new in this latest patch:

Gameplay Improvements


[]Comparing secondary weapons will no longer cause a display issue.
[]Improved sounds and increased volume for melee weapons for a more immersive combat experience.
[]Crafting can no longer be applied to glitched items, ensuring a smoother crafting experience.
[]Fixed issues with lost and incorrectly allocated specialization points, so you can build your character as intended.
[]Auto-Reload added: Now automatically reload when not in a fighting stance, enhancing the flow of combat.
[]Increased auto-loot range for auto-destroy and auto-sell with pets to streamline item management.
[]Updated passives descriptions to provide clearer information.
[]increase the number of enemies on the map.


New Options


New volume option: Weapons now have their own sound volume setting in the options menu, giving you more control over your auditory experience.


Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re committed to continuously improving Seven Cities. Keep sharing your thoughts and helping us shape the best hack and slash experience on Steam!

Thanks for your ongoing support!
